description: Total RNA was processed to generate labeled ss-cDNA, which was hybridized to GeneChip Human Gene ST Arrays, followed by washing, staining, scanning, and data analysis.
span_chunk: The GeneChip WT PLUS reagent kit (Affymetrix) was used to produce amplified, fragmented and labeled sense-strand DNA targets from total RNA.

description: RNAi was performed by growing worms on plates seeded with bacteria expressing double-stranded RNA corresponding to target genes.
span_chunk: Worms for rpa-1(RNAi) and rad-51(RNAi) were bleached and embryos placed on OP-50 NGM plates and allowed to grow to L4s before being placed on prepared RNAi plates for 24 h, and microirradiated.

description: Live imaging slides were made and microirradiation was performed, followed by imaging of the bend region of each gonadal arm at specified time points post-microirradiation.
span_chunk: Apoptosis assay Live imaging slides were made and microirradiation was performed as described above, except the strain CED-1::GFP; GFP::RAD-51; spo-11 was used.

description: Worms homozygous for GFP::COSA-1, GFP::ZYG-12 and spo-11 deletion were subjected to irradiation, recovered, and dissected to score GFP::COSA-1 foci in the late pachytene region of each germline.
span_chunk: COSA-1 assay Worms homozygous for GFP::COSA-1, GFP::ZYG-12 and spo-11 deletion were subjected to irradiation as indicated above, except all TZ nuclei were targeted.

task_name: In vitro translation and binding assay
description: Purifying GST proteins, generating 35S-methionine labeled proteins, performing in vitro binding assays, and imaging by autoradiography.
span_chunk: GST proteins were purified as previously described[ 50 ]. [...] All samples, including inputs were then incubated at 95°C for 5 minutes before being resolved by SDS-PAGE and imaged by autoradiography.

task_name: Flow cytometry of HSV-1-eGFP infected cells
description: Hela cells transfected with siRNA SMARTpools were infected with HSV-1-eGFP and analyzed by flow cytometry.
span_chunk: Select siRNAs SMARTpools were diluted to 500 nM in HBSS and 100 µl was incubated with 100 µl Dharmafect 1 diluted in HBSS to a final concentration of 0.15% in individual wells of a 12-well plate. After 20 min incubation, 2×10 5 Hela cells in 800 µl transfection medium were added. After 48 h, medium was removed, cells rinsed in PBS and dislodged by trypsinisation. Cells were washed in PBS and pelleted by centrifugation for 10 min at 199 g. Supernatant was removed and cells fixed in 4% paraformaldehyde before analysing for eGFP expression by flow cytometry (FACS DiVa, BD Biosciences) using the CellQuest software package.

description: eGFP-HE was partially purified from E. coli cells using a series of steps including lysis, centrifugation, and ammonium sulfate precipitation.
span_chunk: Partial purification of eGFP-HE E. coli eGFP-HE was partially purified from E. coli strain RL1314... The resulting material was precipitated with 50% saturated ammonium sulfate (35 g/100 mL) and resuspended in 500 µL dialysis buffer.

description: In vitro synthesized 6S M RNA was added to TO3-Dtb and eGFP-HE, incubated, and analyzed using a Typhoon Trio+ Variable Mode Imager.
span_chunk: Two-color gel-imaging analysis of the Mango and eGFP-tagged 6S:RNAP complex In vitro synthesized 6S M RNA (1 µM) was added to 2 µM TO3-Dtb and one-tenth of the reaction volume of the partially purified eGFP-HE in 15 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 90 mM KCl, 0.75 mM DTT and 75 µg/mL heparin.

description: The two-photon spectrum of 6S M:TO3-Dtb was obtained and fluorescence cross-correlation spectroscopy was performed with varying amounts of RNAP-eGFP extract.
span_chunk: Two-photon spectrum and cross-correlation experiments sample conditions The two-photon spectrum of 6S M:TO3-Dtb was obtained by measuring fluorescence intensity... Fluorescence cross-correlation spectroscopy was performed by adding increasing amounts of RNAP-eGFP extract to a fixed amount of 6S M and TO3-Dtb.

description: Peptides from cell lysates were analyzed by LC-MS/MS and data were processed for quantitation.
span_chunk: Peptides from processed lysates 29 of cell pellets were separated by capillary liquid chromatography (LC) and analysed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) using the RSLCnano system and LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

description: Statistical analyses were performed on the collected data using Prism and R software.
span_chunk: Statistical analyses were performed using Prism (GraphPad, La Jolla, CA, USA) with two-tailed tests described in the text 31. Mass spectrometry data were analysed using R (OSX v2.15.1); expression levels were log 2 median-normalized and analysed using t-tests, and p values converted to false discovery rates using Benjamini–Hochberg methodology 32.

task_name: Normalization, peak calling, and overlaps analysis
description: Mapped BAM files were normalized, peaks were called using MACS2, and overlaps were calculated with ChIPpeakAnno package.
span_chunk: The mapped BAM files were normalized to RPKMs using deepTools, and bigwig coverage files were generated. Peak calling was performed using MACS2.

task_name: Quantification of tubule diameter in inhibitor assay
description: Performing immunostaining, imaging, and calculating the diameter of epididymal tubules after inhibitor treatment.
span_chunk: First, we performed immunostaining for E-cadherin for each inhibitor treatment to visualize the epididymal tubule [...] Then, we manually extracted epididymal tubules from maximum intensity projection images [...] and finally calculated the diameter along the centre line of tubule.

task_name: Cell intercalation rate for tube elongation (CITE) analysis
description: Obtaining time-lapsed volumetric images, analyzing cell intercalation dynamics, and calculating the cell intercalation strain rate tensor.
span_chunk: We first obtained time-lapsed volumetric images for epithelial dynamics from the head region of four different samples at E15.5 by live imaging [...] Next, based on an earlier study, we calculated the cell intercalation strain rate tensor LIt at time t as follows: [...]

description: Employing a vertex dynamics model to represent multicellular dynamics in epithelial tissues and simulating cell intercalation, proliferation, and tube formation.
span_chunk: We employed a vertex dynamics model (VDM), a type of cell-oriented model, to represent multicellular dynamics in epithelial tissues [...] In this study, we identified apical junctions of the epididymal tubule on which only pMRLC, a marker of tension generation, is localized [...]

description: Data were analysed using either Kurskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn’s multiple comparison test or two-way analysis of variance, followed by Tukey’s post hoc test using GraphPad Prism 6 software.
span_chunk: The data were analysed using either Kurskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn’s multiple comparation test or two-way analysis of variance, followed by Tukey’s post hoc test by using GraphPad Prism 6 software (GraphPad Software, San Diego, California, USA).

description: GUS activity was assayed histochemically, and stained leaves were observed using a microscope.
span_chunk: GUS activity was assayed histochemically with 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolyl-β-D-glucuronic acid (1 mg/ml) in a buffer containing 100 mM sodium phosphate pH 7.0, 0.5 mM potassium ferrocyanide, 0.5 mM potassium ferricyanide, 10 mM EDTA, 0.1% Triton.

description: Plants were treated with SA solution, incubated, and then used for RNA extraction to analyze PR1 expression.
span_chunk: For SA-induced PR1 expression analysis as shown in Figure 6A, ten-day-old plants grown on MS medium plates were used. The plants were equilibrated in water overnight, and water was changed for 100 µM SA (Sigma) solution in the morning.

task_name: Analyze splicing activity of TDP43 variants
description: Use the splicing reporter assay to analyze the splicing activity of exogenous full-length TDP43 and its variants in TDP43−/− cells.
span_chunk: We used the splicing reporter assay to analyze the splicing activity of exogenous full-length TDP43 and its variants in TDP43−/− cells.

task_name: Test endogenous splicing in stable cell lines
description: Re-introduce GFP-tagged, full-length TDP43 variants into TDP43−/− HEK-293T cells by stable transduction and analyze the presence of cryptic exons in endogenous mRNA targets.
span_chunk: Therefore, we re-introduced GFP-tagged, full-length TDP43 variants into TDP43−/− HEK-293T cells by stable transduction and analyzed the presence of cryptic exons in endogenous mRNA targets.
